section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Earned & Remaining
title: Completing a work order moves all approved labor and parts to Earned
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 4 S4-R15a; S4-R16a; S4-R18a - a completed work order holds no Remaining whatever was clocked or received; ruled by Chris Ward 2026-08-13; raised by SV-9119)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned, Parts Remaining, Earned and Remaining columns are all turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. A ZZAUTOTEST work order exists with one approved labor line quoted at 4.0 hours at $100 per hour - $400.00 quoted - with only 1.0 hour clocked to it.
4. The same work order has one approved parts line of 4 units at $50.00 sell each - $200.00 - of which only 2 units have been received.
5. That work order's status is In Progress, so it is listed in the "Approved - partially completed" tab.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and select the "Approved - partially completed" tab.
2. Find the seeded work order's row and write down its Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned and Parts Remaining values.
3. Open that work order and set its status to Complete.
4. Go back to the Work In Progress report and reload it, then select the "Completed" tab.
5. Find the same work order's row and read Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned, Parts Remaining, Earned and Remaining.
expected:
1. Before the work order is completed it is listed in the "Approved - partially completed" tab and shows only the approved work actually performed - in the example $100.00 Labor Earned with $300.00 Labor Remaining, and $100.00 Parts Earned with $100.00 Parts Remaining.
2. After the work order is completed it is listed in the "Completed" tab.
3. Labor Earned now shows the full quoted value of every approved labor line - $400.00 in the example - whatever hours were clocked to it. Clocked time stops driving the number once the work order is completed.
4. Labor Remaining shows $0.00.
5. Parts Earned now shows the sell value of every approved-line part - $200.00 in the example - whatever quantity was received.
6. Parts Remaining shows $0.00.
7. The row's Remaining is $0.00 as well: a completed work order leaves no approved value sitting in Remaining.
8. An under-clocked or part-received work order jumping to its full approved value on completion is the expected result here, not a data error.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4, S4-R15a, S4-R16a and S4-R18a), read on 26 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its story SV-8660.
